newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius index slips down in higher volume.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius index slips down in higher volume.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index, semdex, slipped down by 1.18 points to 326.74 on Friday under the weight of falling prices of leading shares on the list, brokers said.
Turnover rose to 9.74 million rupees on 658,571 shares from 4.94 million rupees with 204,202 shares on Wednesday.

Brokers said State Bank of Mauritius rose to an all time high after local media reported an unnamed international financial institution would take a stake in the island's second largest bank as part of a strategic alliance.
State Bank rose 10 cents to 8.80 rupees on 25,400 shares.
Share rises in of State Bank was offset by falling stocks of other leading listed companies with the net result of the index losing ground, brokers said.
"But the market does not look to have a definite general trend. Investors are still waiting for the new finance minister," one broker said.
Mauritian prime minister said he would announce a government cabinet reshuffle before parliament reconvenes from holiday on November 26.
Mauritius Commercial Bank lost 50 cents to 73 rupees on 1,913 shares. Mauritius Oil Refineries was unchanged at 9.50 rupees on 39,192 shares.
In the investment sector, Promotion And Development (PAD) was 30 cents lower to 15 rupees on 1,750 shares and Policy fell by 10 cents to 3.40 rupees on 16,000 shares.
Consolidated Investment Trust was 20 cents down to 8.80 rupees on 507,292 shares but National Investment Trust rose 20 cents to 11.80 rupees on 2,120 shares.
Sugar stock Mon Tresor Mon Desert was 20 cents higher to 37.70 rupees on 5,000 shares. Conglomerate Rogers edged up by 50 cents to 91 rupees on 500 shares.
Happy World Foods fell by 30 cents to 15.50 rupees on 10,226 shares and national carrier Air Mauritius shed 30 cents to 49.70 rupees on 260 shares.
Hotels concerns Sun Resorts was 1 rupee down to 35 rupees on 3,270 shares and New Mauritius Hotels eased 10 cents to 29.40 rupees on 5,010 shares.
